quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.catalogDescription: Add or remove exercises, then return to settings.
quickStart.settingsDescription: Tune settings, add exercises if you need them, then continue or save as a reusable program.
quickStart.promptDescription: You can save these exercises to your Program Library, or continue with a one-off session.
quickStart.needExercise: You need to add at least one exercise.

sessionDialog.title: Session Completed
sessionDialog.description: Choose how to save this session and any supplemental therapies used outside VR.
sessionDialog.overwriteWarning: This will overwrite the exercises and settings in your Program Library program. Past sessions stay unchanged.

casting.title: Casting
casting.timeoutTitle: Casting is taking longer than expected
casting.timeoutDescription: The VR headset stream has not appeared yet. You can keep waiting or cancel casting.
casting.idleDescription: Start casting to view the VR headset stream.
casting.errorDescription: Check the device connection and try again.

vrControl.clientDescription: Console connection to the VR headset.

headsetDialog.didntRespond: Headset didn't respond. Check it's on and the app is open.
headsetDialog.downloadDisconnected: The headset disconnected before confirming the download. When it reconnects, check the list. If the video isn't downloading, click Download again.
headsetDialog.playDisconnected: The headset disconnected before confirming playback. When it reconnects, check the list. If the video isn't playing, press Play again.
headsetDialog.stopDidntRespond: Headset didn't confirm the stop. Check it's on and the app is open, then press Stop again.
headsetDialog.stopDisconnected: The headset disconnected before confirming the stop. When it reconnects, check whether the video is still playing on the headset.
headsetDialog.replacedDescription: Another tab is now controlling this headset. Close this tab, or continue in the active one.

socket.rejected: Socket connection was rejected by server.

mirrorError.notFound: This headset is not linked to your account; the download request was not saved.

mirrorError.generic: The download request could not be saved.
